core_obligations: Reduce: syntomic/smooth/\'etaleness are \'etale local on source and target, so assume $B$ and $Y$ are affine schemes (proof lines 974-982).
Chart: $|X| \to |Y|$ is open, so choose an affine scheme $U$ \'etale over $X$ with $U \to Y$ surjective (proof lines 982-986).
Conclude $q$ syntomic (resp. smooth, \'etale) by the scheme-side permanence lemma (proof lines 986-989).
proof_roadmap: Use \'etale locality to make $B$ and $Y$ affine.
Get a surjective \'etale affine chart of $X$ via openness.
difficulty_reason: Explicit \'etale reduction: the problem is \'etale local on $B$ and $Y$ by the three cited locality lemmas, so $B, Y$ may be taken affine schemes; openness of $|X| \to |Y|$ yields an affine $U$ \'etale over $X$ mapping surjectively to $Y$; the scheme-side permanence lemma concludes.
